import ast

for fname in ['test_m1.py', 'test_m2.py', 'test_m3.py']:
    path = f'crucible_hidden/{fname}'
    with open(path) as f:
        content = f.read()
    tree = ast.parse(content)
    funcs = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_')]
    print(f"{fname}: {len(funcs)} tests")
    for f in funcs:
        # Check that imports are inside the function body
        has_import = False
        for node in ast.walk(f):
            if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
                has_import = True
                break
        print(f"  - {f.name} (imports inside: {has_import})")
